items.title: 不想讓OpenAI等巨頭壟斷AI！祖克柏開放Meta最強模型
items.title_en: Don't Let Giants Like OpenAI Monopolize AI! Zuckerberg Opens Meta's Strongest Model
paras: Meta Platforms(META-US)宣布將開放旗下最強人工智慧 (AI) 模型的權重，並推出可直接在消費性裝置運行的新模型，藉此挑戰 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 等採取封閉模式的領先 AI 實驗室。Meta 周一盤前上漲 2.1%。
執行長祖克柏 (Mark Zuckerberg) 周一 (10 日) 透過 Instagram 影片表示，Meta 將開放最新 AI 模型 Muse Spark 1.2 的權重，允許大眾下載及使用。模型權重是決定 AI 如何運作與回應的一系列參數與規則。
Meta 也將推出名為 Muse Glimmer 的全新開放模型系列，主要特色是能直接在筆記型電腦上運行，不必完全依賴昂貴的雲端資料中心。

Meta 押注開放權重 挑戰中國 AI 模型

OpenAI 及 Anthropic 主要採用封閉模型，但阿里巴巴 (BABA-US)(09988-HK)、深度求索(DeepSeek) 及月之暗面 (Moonshot) 等中國業者近年積極推出開放權重模型，部分產品的能力已足以與美國領先技術競爭。
祖克柏周一發表一篇長達 6,500 字的 AI 文章，將 Meta 的行動定位為美國對中國開放 AI 技術的反擊，並呼籲華府降低美國業者開發開放模型時面臨的政策障礙。
他表示，外國 AI 實驗室目前擁有多項優勢，原因是美國業者在訓練資料方面必須遵守更多限制。若美國希望其開放模型長期保持領先，政策就必須降低這些額外摩擦。
祖克柏反對限制取得外國開放模型，認為美國真正的目標應是打造全球最優秀的開放模型，而非阻止開發者使用中國技術。
Counterpoint Research 共同創辦人 Neil Shah 指出，如果西方科技巨擘只建立封閉的「圍牆花園」，開發者及企業自然會轉向中國開放權重模型。由於美國多數競爭對手仍採封閉策略，市場對非中國開放模型存在龐大需求，Meta 有機會填補這項空缺。
Muse Glimmer 的裝置端設計也成為 Meta 與其他業者區隔的重要特點。目前多數 AI 服務均由雲端資料中心處理，直接在個人電腦或手機上運行，則可降低雲端運算成本、縮短回應時間，並可能協助 Meta 在終端裝置上挑戰 Google 及微軟。

暗批 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 反對 AI 權力集中

祖克柏表示，美國若想在開放 AI 領域取得領導地位，就必須重新檢討模型蒸餾及訓練資料使用等政策。模型蒸餾通常是利用先進模型的輸出訓練另一個模型，但部分美國議員認為，這種做法可能涉及竊取智慧財產權。
祖克柏也警告，不應將 AI 能力集中在少數企業手中，相關言論被視為暗批 OpenAI 及 Anthropic。他質疑，如果有人認為 AI 將消滅多數工作、削弱人類的重要性，為何仍急於打造這樣的未來；宣稱 AI 太危險，因此只能將權力極度集中，同樣存在根本問題。
Anthropic 執行長阿莫戴 (Dario Amodei) 及 OpenAI 執行長阿特曼 (Sam Altman) 過去均曾警告 AI 對就業的衝擊，儘管 Altman 近期已稍微淡化相關說法。
祖克柏主張，與其集中超級智慧，更應廣泛分配 AI 能力，讓每個人都能掌握並運用。他預期，未來每個人都將擁有能力極強的個人 AI 代理，理解使用者、個人目標及其重視的一切。
Meta 今年資本支出預估最高達 1,450 億美元，股價今年來仍下跌約 10%。在投資人持續檢視龐大 AI 支出及競爭能力之際，祖克柏正試圖證明去年成立的 Meta 超級智慧實驗室已取得進展，相關投資最終能帶來回報。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) announced it will open the weights of its most powerful artificial intelligence (AI) model and launch a new model that can run directly on consumer devices, aiming to challenge leading AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic that use closed approaches. Meta rose 2.1% pre‑market on Monday.

CEO Mark Zuckerberg said in an Instagram video on Monday (the 10th) that Meta will release the weights of its latest AI model Muse Spark 1.2, allowing the public to download and use them. Model weights are the set of parameters and rules that determine how the AI operates and responds.
Meta will also roll out a brand‑new open‑model series called Muse Glimmer, whose main feature is the ability to run directly on laptops without relying entirely on expensive cloud data centers.

Meta bets on open weights to challenge Chinese AI models. While OpenAI and Anthropic mainly use closed models, Chinese players such as Alibaba (BABA-US)(09988‑HK), DeepSeek and Moonshot have recently been active in releasing open‑weight models, with some products already competitive with leading U.S. technology.

Zuckerberg published a 6,500‑word article on Monday positioning Meta’s move as a U.S. counter‑offensive to China’s open AI efforts and urging Washington to lower policy barriers that U.S. firms face when developing open models.

He noted that foreign AI labs currently enjoy several advantages because U.S. companies must comply with more restrictions on training data. If the U.S. wants its open models to stay ahead in the long run, policy must reduce these extra frictions.

Zuckerberg opposes limiting access to foreign open models, arguing that America’s real goal should be to build the world’s best open model rather than prevent developers from using Chinese technology.

Neil Shah, co‑founder of Counterpoint Research, warned that if Western tech giants only build closed “walled gardens,” developers and enterprises will naturally turn to Chinese open‑weight models. Because most U.S. competitors remain closed, there is huge demand for non‑Chinese open models, giving Meta an opportunity to fill that gap.

The device‑side design of Muse Glimmer is also a key differentiator for Meta versus other players. Most AI services today run in cloud data centers; running directly on a personal computer or phone can cut cloud‑computing costs, shorten response times, and potentially help Meta challenge Google and Microsoft on the endpoint.

Zuckerberg subtly criticized OpenAI and Anthropic for opposing AI power concentration. He said the U.S. must revisit policies on model distillation and training‑data use if it wants to lead in open AI. Model distillation—training a new model on the outputs of a more advanced one—has been flagged by some U.S. lawmakers as potentially infringing intellectual‑property rights.

He also warned that AI capabilities should not be concentrated in a few companies, a comment seen as a veiled jab at OpenAI and Anthropic. He questioned why anyone would rush to build a future where AI eliminates most jobs and diminishes human importance, then claim AI is too dangerous and therefore must be tightly controlled, calling that a fundamental problem.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman have both warned about AI’s impact on employment, although Altman has recently softened his rhetoric.

Zuckerberg argues that instead of concentrating superintelligence, AI capability should be widely distributed so everyone can harness it. He envisions a future where each person has a highly capable personal AI agent that understands the user, personal goals, and what matters to them.

Meta’s capital expenditures this year are projected to top $145 billion, and its stock is down about 10% year‑to‑date. As investors continue to scrutinize massive AI spending and competitive positioning, Zuckerberg is trying to prove that the Meta Superintelligence Lab, founded last year, is making progress and that the investment will ultimately pay off.

items.title: 不只賣比特幣還賣股票 Strategy一周套現逾7億美元
items.title_en: Strategy Sells Over $700 Million in Bitcoin and Stocks in One Week
paras: 塞勒 (Michael Saylor) 旗下 Strategy(MSTR-US)持續調整資本結構，上周同步出售比特幣與普通股，以擴充現金儲備並回購特別股。
Strategy 周一 (10 日) 表示，截至 8 月 9 日止的七天內，公司出售價值 1.086 億美元的比特幣，並賣出 660 萬股普通股，籌得約 6.53 億美元；同時斥資 1.086 億美元回購代號 STRC、名為 Stretch 的特別股。目前 Strategy 持有的比特幣總值約 580 億美元，仍是全球持有比特幣最多的上市公司。
Strategy 過去憑藉長期大量買進比特幣而聲名大噪，但隨著市場對其融資模式及股權稀釋風險的疑慮升高，塞勒自 5 月底將策略重心轉向資本管理。此後，公司已累計出售約 4.32 億美元比特幣，並將現金儲備提高至約 46 億美元。
為緩解投資人對普通股遭稀釋的擔憂，Saylor 先前曾試圖將發行 STRC 特別股作為公司主要融資來源。然而，STRC 自 5 月初以來一直未能站上 100 美元面額，導致公司難以透過發行該證券有效募資，目前市價約為 95 美元。
Strategy 原本是一家企業軟體公司，後來轉型為比特幣囤積者。身兼共同創辦人及執行董事長的塞勒過去曾鼓勵投資人想盡辦法買進比特幣，如今卻為強化財務韌性而持續賣幣，顯示公司的資本策略正出現明顯轉變。
paras_en: Michael Saylor's Strategy (MSTR-US) continues to adjust its capital structure, selling both Bitcoin and common stock last week to expand its cash reserves and repurchase its special stock.

Strategy announced on Monday (10th) that within the seven days ending August 9, the company sold Bitcoin worth $1.086 billion and sold 6.6 million common shares, raising approximately $653 million; simultaneously, it invested $1.086 billion to repurchase its special stock, designated as STRC, named Stretch.

Strategy previously gained attention for its long-term large-scale purchases of Bitcoin, but as concerns about its financing model and equity dilution risks increased, Saylor shifted the company's strategy to capital management from the end of May.

To alleviate investor concerns about common stock dilution, Saylor previously attempted to use the issuance of STRC special stock as the company's primary source of financing. However, STRC has not exceeded $100 since May 1, making it difficult for the company to effectively raise capital through the issuance of that security, currently trading at around $95.

Originally a corporate software company, Strategy later transformed into a Bitcoin hoarder. As both co-founder and executive chairman, Saylor previously encouraged investors to buy Bitcoin at all costs, but now continues to sell Bitcoin to strengthen its financial resilience, indicating a significant shift in the company's capital strategy.

items.title: 560億美元收購喊卡？GameStop擬改與eBay合作
items.title_en: US$56 billion acquisition called off? GameStop plans to shift to partnership with eBay
paras: 外媒周一 (10 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，由執行長柯恩 (Ryan Cohen) 領導的 GameStop(GME-US) 正考慮撤回對 eBay(EBAY-US) 提出的 560 億美元收購案，轉而尋求建立合作夥伴關係或合資企業。
消息人士指出，柯恩可能提議讓 eBay 運用 GameStop 在美國約 1,600 家實體門市，協助雙方擴大在交換卡片及收藏品等高毛利商品市場的市占率。GameStop 身為 eBay 主要股東之一，也將在合作案中尋求取得 eBay 董事會席次。
GameStop 今年 5 月向 eBay 提出每股 125 美元的收購價，其中 50% 以現金支付，另外 50% 則以 GameStop 普通股支付。不過，自收購案提出以來，GameStop 股價已下跌 28%，eBay 股價則上漲 7.6%，使原本以股票支付的部分吸引力下降。
eBay 上周五收在 111.98 美元，市值約 498 億美元；若計入債務，企業價值接近 540 億美元。知情人士強調，GameStop 尚未做出最終決定，柯恩仍可能評估其他方案。兩家公司均未立即回應置評要求。
這項收購提案原本是 Cohen 在 GameStop 建立 eBay 約 5% 持股後採取的大膽行動。GameStop 隨後持續加碼，截至 7 月 15 日持股比率已升至 9.75%，成為 eBay 第二大股東，持股規模僅次於 Vanguard Group 旗下基金。
儘管 GameStop 目前持有 84 億美元現金，可用於支持潛在交易，但其市值已降至約 86 億美元，遠低於 eBay。知名投資人貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 先前也因擔心 GameStop 可能為收購案背負龐大債務，在提案公布後出清全部持股。
GameStop 過去以電玩實體零售店為主，但隨著玩家轉向線上購買遊戲，公司已大幅縮減門市規模，並嘗試轉型。該公司 2021 年曾成為散戶投機熱潮的核心標的。
eBay 近年雖面臨消費習慣改變及成長放緩等挑戰，但其平台每年商品交易額仍約 800 億美元。截至 3 月 31 日止的 12 個月內，全球約有 1.36 億名消費者曾在 eBay 平台購物。
paras_en: Foreign media on Monday (the 10th) citing sources reported that GameStop (GME-US) led by CEO Ryan Cohen is considering withdrawing its $56 billion acquisition offer for eBay (EBAY-US) and instead seeking to establish a partnership or joint venture.

Sources say Cohen may propose that eBay use GameStop’s roughly 1,600 physical stores in the United States to help both parties increase market share in high‑margin goods such as trading cards and collectibles. As one of eBay’s major shareholders, GameStop would also seek a seat on eBay’s board in the cooperation.

In May this year GameStop offered eBay $125 per share, half in cash and half in GameStop common stock. However, since the bid was announced, GameStop’s share price has fallen 28%, while eBay’s has risen 7.6%, reducing the attractiveness of the stock‑based portion.

eBay closed last Friday at $111.98, giving it a market cap of about $49.8 billion; including debt, enterprise value is close to $54 billion. Sources stress that GameStop has not made a final decision and Cohen may still evaluate other options. Neither company responded immediately to requests for comment.

The acquisition proposal was originally a bold move by Cohen after building roughly a 5% stake in eBay through GameStop. GameStop then continued to increase its holding, reaching 9.75% as of July 15, making it eBay’s second‑largest shareholder behind Vanguard Group funds.

Although GameStop currently holds $8.4 billion in cash that could fund a potential deal, its market value has slipped to about $8.6 billion, far below eBay’s. Prominent investor Michael Burry previously sold all his shares after the proposal, fearing GameStop might take on massive debt from the acquisition.

GameStop historically operated physical video‑game retail stores, but as gamers shifted to online purchases the company has dramatically reduced its store footprint and is trying to transform. The firm was a core target of the retail‑investor frenzy in 2021.

eBay has faced challenges in recent years from changing consumer habits and slowing growth, yet its platform still processes roughly $80 billion in gross merchandise volume annually. In the twelve months ended March 31, about 136 million consumers worldwide shopped on eBay.

items.title: 不想再看輝達臉色！微軟向台積電要產能 Maia 300大舉擴產
items.title_en: Microsoft Seeks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Capacity for Maia 300
paras: 微軟 (MSFT-US) 計劃大幅提高新一代自研人工智慧 (AI) 晶片產量，並爭取 Anthropic 等大型雲端客戶採用，以降低對輝達(NVDA-US)AI 加速器的依賴。
科技媒體《The Information》周一 (10 日) 引述知情人士報導，微軟準備在今年秋季發布新一代 AI 晶片 Maia 300，最快可能於 8 月亮相，正式發布時間則預計落在 9 月。微軟已與台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 洽談產能，希望取得超過 30 萬顆 Maia 300 的製造能力，預計於 2027 年交付。
Maia 300 是微軟自研 AI 加速器系列的升級產品，主要用於滿足 Azure 雲端平台持續成長的 AI 運算需求。報導指出，微軟希望透過擴大產量及導入大型客戶，加速建立自有 AI 晶片生態系。一名微軟主管未評論具體生產計畫，但表示公司最終目標是讓 Maia 晶片的部署規模達到數吉瓦。
不過，微軟目前使用的 Maia 200 市場採用速度仍相對緩慢。儘管公司已投入大量資金開發專用 AI 晶片，客戶轉換既有運算架構及進行大規模部署仍面臨挑戰。
隨著生成式 AI 帶動運算需求急升，大型雲端服務商正加速發展自研晶片，以降低對輝達 GPU 供應鏈的依賴。除微軟之外，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下 Google 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 也已推出自有 AI 晶片，科技巨擘之間的晶片競賽持續升溫。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) plans to significantly increase production of its next-generation self-developed artificial intelligence (AI) chips, and is seeking to win over large cloud customers such as Anthropic to reduce its dependence on NVIDIA (NVDA-US) AI accelerators.

According to a report by The Information on Monday (10th), Microsoft is preparing to release its next-generation AI chip, Maia 300, as early as August, with a formal release planned for September. Microsoft has been in talks with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM-US) (2330-TW) to secure production capacity of over 300,000 Maia 300 units, with delivery expected in 2027.

Maia 300 is an upgraded product in Microsoft's self-developed AI accelerator series, primarily used to meet the growing AI computing demands of the Azure cloud platform. The report states that Microsoft hopes to accelerate the establishment of its own AI chip ecosystem by expanding production and introducing large customers. A Microsoft executive declined to comment on specific production plans, but stated that the company's ultimate goal is to deploy Maia chips at a scale of tens of gigawatts.

However, the adoption rate of Microsoft's current Maia 200 in the market remains relatively slow. Despite investing heavily in developing dedicated AI chips, customers face challenges in transitioning to new computing architectures and deploying them on a large scale.

As generative AI drives up computing demands, large cloud service providers are accelerating the development of self-developed chips to reduce their dependence on NVIDIA's GPU supply chain. In addition to Microsoft, Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) Google and Amazon (AMZN-US) have also launched their own AI chips, and the chip competition between tech giants continues to heat up.

items.title: 統一中國飲品賣不動了 半年報營收近五年來首現下滑
items.title_en: Uni-President China's Sales Slump for the First Time in Five Years
paras: 近日統一企業中國 (00220-HK) 公布 2026 年上半年財報，整體經營保持正增長，但兩大主營業務呈現冷熱分化格局，營收基本盤飲品業務收益回落，近五年首次下滑。
財報顯示，今年上半年統一企業中國整體營收達到人民幣 173.21 億元，較去年同期小幅成長 1.4%，歸母淨利潤 14.02 億元，增加 9%，綜合毛利率優化至 35%。
佔據總營收超過六成的飲品業務，上半年營收為 107.51 億元，較一年前微降 0.3%，結束多年上半年飲品業務持續走高的態勢。財報顯示，飲品業務毛利率上浮 0.5% 至 39.9%。
拆分飲品各細分品類看，傳統含糖瓶裝產品成為主要業績拖累，支柱品類茶飲料上半年營收為 48.89 億元，較去年同期下滑 3.5%，佔飲品整體收入近半數；果汁業務也不好看，營收 17.21 億元，下降幅度達到 5.5%。
曾經佔據線下冰櫃核心位置的冰紅茶、統一綠茶、鮮橙多等經典單品終端銷量放緩，不少經銷商反應常規大瓶裝飲品庫存周轉速度下降。
在全品類整體承壓情況下，奶茶賽道成為增長支點。上半年奶茶業務營收為 36.45 億元，較去年同期成長 7.3%。老牌爆款阿薩姆奶茶銷量保持穩定，低糖茉莉奶綠是奶茶業務全新增長主力，咖啡、包裝水等其餘飲品品類小幅走低。
據《界面新聞》10 日（周一）報導，消費偏好變化、行業環境轉變是統一飲料銷量遇冷的誘因。公開數據表明，2026 年上半年中國規模以上飲料總產量較一年前下滑 0.5%，也是近五年飲料行業首次上半年產量下降，整個瓶裝飲品賽道正式邁入存量博弈階段。
尼爾森 IQ 監測數據顯示，今年 5 月中國飲品全渠道銷售額年降 8.7%，消費者健康化的消費偏好重塑飲品市場格局，無糖茶飲迎來高速擴張，含糖瓶裝茶、常溫果汁受眾持續縮減。
市場多線分流同樣擠壓統一傳統飲品的生存空間，一方面無糖茶飲賽道競品搶先布局市場份額，現製茶飲搶佔年輕群體休閒飲用場景；另一方面零食折扣店、會員商超興起，定製款平價飲品打擊傳統流通渠道。
paras_en: Uni-President China (00220-HK) released its 2026 first-half financial report, showing overall operations maintained positive growth, but two major business segments presented a differentiated pattern, with basic plate beverage business revenue declining, marking the first time in five years.

The report showed that Uni-President China's total revenue reached RMB 173.21 billion in the first half of this year, up 1.4% year-on-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.02 billion, up 9%, and comprehensive gross margin optimized to 35%.

The beverage business, which accounted for more than 60% of total revenue, had a revenue of RMB 107.51 billion in the first half, down 0.3% from a year ago, ending the long-standing trend of continuous growth in the first half of the year. The report showed that the beverage business gross margin rose 0.5% to 39.9%.

Breaking down the beverage business by sub-category, traditional sugared bottled products became the main drag on performance, with the pillar category of tea drinks having a revenue of RMB 48.89 billion in the first half, down 3.5% from a year ago, accounting for nearly half of the total income of the beverage business; the juice business was also not good, with a revenue of RMB 17.21 billion, a decline of 5.5%.

Classic single products such as ice red tea, Uni-President green tea, and fresh orange juice, which once occupied the core position of offline refrigerators, have seen terminal sales slow down, with many distributors reporting that the inventory turnover speed of regular large-bottled drinks has decreased.

In the overall pressure situation of the entire category, the milk tea track became the growth point. The revenue of the milk tea business in the first half was RMB 36.45 billion, up 7.3% from a year ago. The classic bestseller Assam milk tea maintained stable sales, while low-sugar jasmine milk green tea became the main growth driver of the milk tea business, with coffee, packaged water, and other beverage categories experiencing slight declines.

According to a report by Interface News on October 10 (Monday), changes in consumer preferences and changes in the industry environment are the factors that have led to the decline in sales of Uni-President's drinks. Public data shows that China's large-scale beverage production volume in the first half of 2026 decreased by 0.5% compared to the previous year, marking the first time in five years that the beverage industry has seen a decline in production volume in the first half, and the entire bottled drink track has officially entered the inventory competition stage.

Nielsen IQ monitoring data shows that in May this year, China's beverage sales across all channels decreased by 8.7% year-on-year, and consumers' health-conscious consumption preferences reshaped the beverage market landscape, with low-sugar tea drinks experiencing rapid expansion, and sugared bottled tea and regular temperature juice experiencing a continued decline in popularity.

Market multi-channel diversion has also squeezed the survival space of Uni-President's traditional drinks, with one side being the competition for market share by low-sugar tea drink competitors, who have set up shop in the market, and the other side being the rise of discount stores and membership supermarkets, which have launched customized low-priced drinks to attack traditional distribution channels.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉荷姆茲僵局推升油價與美債殖利率 主要指數平盤震盪
paras: 美股主要指數周一 (10 日) 開盤變動不大，標普 500 指數在創下歷史新高後於平盤附近震盪。美國與伊朗短期內達成持久協議的希望降溫，加上荷姆茲海峽恢復通航仍未取得進展，推升布蘭特原油至每桶 85 美元。
能源成本走高加劇通膨疑慮，市場擔心即使就業市場近期降溫，Fed 今年仍可能升息，帶動美國公債殖利率及美元上揚。本周多項關鍵通膨數據與企業財報公布前，投資人態度轉趨謹慎；個股方面，英特爾 (INTC-US) 宣布發股募資後走低。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌逾 70 點或近 0.1%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近 80 點或 近 0.3%，標普 500 指數跌近 0.1%，費城半導體指數跌近 1.0%。台積電 ADR 跌 0.7%。
美股期指周一在歷史高點附近震盪，投資人一方面等待本周公布的美國消費者物價指數 (CPI)，另一方面持續關注荷姆茲海峽恢復通航的談判進展。由於伊朗與阿曼尚未達成協議，國際油價維持在每桶 84 美元以上。
標普 500 指數上周五收在歷史新高後，美股期指顯示周一開盤波動可能有限。美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 2 個基點至 4.66%，美元兌多數十國集團 (G10) 貨幣小幅走高。
隨著企業財報季大致告一段落，市場焦點重新轉向地緣政治及通膨。AcomeA Sgr 投資組合經理 Fabio Caldato 表示，伊朗局勢對油價及通膨預期的影響，可能再度成為市場主軸，周三公布的美國 CPI 將是檢驗通膨降溫趨勢的重要關卡。
由於伊朗與阿曼仍未就荷姆茲海峽航線達成協議，油價一度上漲 1.7%。與此同時，也門胡塞武裝宣稱攻擊紅海附近的一座沙國煉油廠，進一步加劇能源供應疑慮。
伊朗外交部長阿拉奇 (Abbas Araghchi) 周末表示，伊朗與阿曼就建立荷姆茲海峽航運路線達成協議已「非常接近」。不過，他以美方違反 6 月達成的臨時和平協議為由，排除現階段與美國直接談判的可能。
匯市方面，近期干預措施對日元的提振效果逐漸消退。日圓兌美元周一貶值 0.7%，報 158.84 日元，交易員正警戒日本與美國可能再度採取官方行動。《彭博》策略師指出，日元是 8 月以來唯一兌美元走貶的 G10 貨幣，隨著投資人重新建立日元空頭部位，再次干預匯市的風險也隨之升高。
儘管宏觀不確定性仍高，華爾街對美股前景依舊樂觀。摩根大通將標普 500 年底目標價由 7,800 點上調至 8,000 點，理由是企業財報強勁，加上大型雲端服務業者的人工智慧 (AI) 變現速度快於預期，帶動獲利預估上升。
摩根大通指出，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 及微軟 (MSFT-US) 的雲端業務成長加速，未完成訂單持續增加，可望緩解市場對 AI 資本支出回報的疑慮。隨著積壓訂單逐步轉化為營收，雲端成長將獲得支撐，也有助證明科技巨擘擴大 AI 投資的合理性。
花旗、德意志銀行及高盛同樣名列今年最看多美股的華爾街機構。市場目前平均預估標普 500 年底將升至 7,845 點，較現有水準約高 1%。

items.title: 中國人形機器人 佔全球出貨量97% 確立早期領先優勢
items.title_en: Chinese Humanoid Robots Account for 97% of Global Shipments, Cementing Early Lead
paras: 市場研究機構 Smart Analytics Global（SAG）的最新行業數據顯示，2026 年上半年中國人形機器人製造商佔全球 97% 以上的出貨量，凸顯中國在這個新興領域確立早期領先優勢。
據《彭博》10 日（周一）報導，SAG 的數據顯示，2026 年上半年全球人形機器人出貨量約 19,100 台，是去年同期的三倍多。
這家總部位於美國加州的咨詢機構預測，今年全年全球人形機器人出貨量有望攀升至 60,000 台左右，並預計在 2030 年衝刺 50 萬台大關。
數據顯示，總部位於上海的智元機器人今年上半年出貨量達到 8,400 台，佔全球出貨量 44%。總部位於杭州的宇樹科技上半年出貨量為 5,900 台。
這兩家中國人形機器人公司的出貨量均遠超特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 、Figure AI 和 Agility Robotics 等美國一線人形機器人公司，凸顯中國人形機器人產業的發展速度。
與此同時，人形機器人的應用場景正發生轉變。SAG 創始人 Linda Sui 表示：「工業與商業應用已佔到總出貨量 70% 以上，去年僅 50% 左右。」
Linda Sui 說道，監管不確定性和地緣政治風險可能影響該行業下一階段增長。
7 月下旬，美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）以國家安全風險為由，宣布禁止進口外國製造的新型人形機器人，此舉被廣泛視為針對中國。
中國外交部對此表示，中方一貫堅決反對美方泛化國家安全概念，打壓中國企業。保護主義提升不了美國的競爭力，只會損害美國企業和消費者的利益。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Market research firm Smart Analytics Global (SAG) reports that in the first half of 2026, Chinese humanoid robot manufacturers shipped more than 97% of the world’s total, highlighting China’s early‑stage advantage in this emerging field.
According to Bloomberg on Monday the 10th, SAG’s data show that global shipments of humanoid robots in the first half of 2026 were about 19,100 units, more than three times the volume a year earlier.
The California‑based consultancy forecasts that worldwide humanoid robot shipments could rise to roughly 60,000 units for the full year and aims for a surge to 500,000 units by 2030.

Data indicate that Shanghai‑based Zhiyuan Robotics shipped 8,400 units in the first half of the year, representing 44% of global shipments, while Hangzhou‑based Yushu Technology shipped 5,900 units in the same period.

Both Chinese firms’ shipment volumes far exceed those of leading U.S. humanoid robot companies such as Tesla (TSLA‑US), Figure AI and Agility Robotics, underscoring the rapid development of China’s humanoid robot industry.

At the same time, the application scenarios for humanoid robots are shifting. SAG founder Linda Sui said, “Industrial and commercial uses now account for over 70% of total shipments, up from roughly 50% last year.”
Linda Sui added that regulatory uncertainty and geopolitical risks could affect the industry’s next phase of growth.

In late July, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) announced a ban on importing newly manufactured foreign humanoid robots on national‑security grounds, a move widely seen as targeting China.

China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded that Beijing consistently opposes the U.S. broadening of national‑security concepts to suppress Chinese firms, noting that protectionism does not boost U.S. competitiveness and only harms American businesses and consumers.

items.title: 嘉威雙箭頭展現成效 第二季轉盈推升上半年每股純益0.68元
items.title_en: Jia Wei's Double Arrow Effect: Second Quarter Profit Boosts Half-Year EPS to 0.68 NT$
paras: 雖處於傳統第二季的淡季，但嘉威生活 (3557-TW) 今 (10) 日公布的最新獲利資訊，上半年中，受惠美國子公司 FDG 轉型貿易模式，加上 Prepara 品牌效應，帶動上半年較去年同期轉虧為盈，稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。嘉威營運走出谷底。公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
嘉威 2026 年第二季營運明顯回溫，營收達 9.64 億元，年增 34.6％，同時，FDG 營運模式轉型、品牌 Prepara 持續成長，以及母公司成本結構優化，第二季毛利率提升至 37.28%，季增 2.95 個百分點，年增 7.14 個百分點，稅後純益 1635 萬元，季減 59.81%，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.19 元。
嘉威上半年營收 23.95 億元，年減 11.8%，主要受到第一季營收下滑影響，不過，隨著第二季營運逐步回升，上半年毛利率仍達 35.52%，較去年同期提升 0.27 百分點；稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。
嘉威指出，上半年主要來自於美國子公司 FDG 及品牌 Prepara 的雙重貢獻，FDG 今年展現爆發式成長，營收衝上 1.88 億元，較去年同期成長高達 8 倍。同時，Prepara 也繳出穩健成績，上半年營收 9000 萬元，年增 25%，有效提升集團海外通路營收規模。
儘管 2026 年第一季受產能配置調整與成本分攤拉高的影響，毛利率降至 34.33%，但第二季已提高到 37.28%，上半年整體平均毛利率達 35.52%，主要受益於 FDG 轉型為進口商貿易模式，貢獻毛利率增加，另外，嘉威銷貨成本結構優化，也貢獻毛利率增加，使整體獲利結構精進，也證明公司在應對市場挑戰與內部策略調整上均取得實質進展。
嘉威今天同時公布 7 月營收，單月營收 2.11 億元，月 42.62%，年增 1.47％；2026 年 1-7 營收 26.06 億元，年減 10.88%。
本周美國將公布美國 7 月 CPI 及 PPI，市場預期通膨壓力略有減緩，若數據符合預期，聯準會有望繼續維持利率不變；另外，雖然就業數據放緩，但 6 月零售銷售年增率仍達 6.7%，顯示消費者支出依舊穩健。嘉威去年面對關稅不確定性，積極調整體質結構，上半年已展現成效，公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
paras_en: Despite being in the traditional second quarter's off-season, Jia Wei Life (3557-TW) announced its latest profit information today, with the company benefiting from its US subsidiary FDG's transformation of its trading model, as well as the Prepara brand effect, leading to a profit of NT$57 million in the first half of the year, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$. Jia Wei's operations have emerged from the trough.

Jia Wei's 2026 second-quarter operations have clearly rebounded, with revenue reaching NT$964 million, a year-on-year increase of 34.6%. At the same time, FDG's operating model transformation, the continuous growth of the Prepara brand, and the optimization of the parent company's cost structure have led to a second-quarter gross margin of 37.28%, an increase of 2.95 percentage points from the previous quarter and a year-on-year increase of 7.14 percentage points. The company's net profit was NT$163.5 million, a decrease of 59.81% from the previous quarter, but an increase of NT$19 million from the same period last year, with an EPS of 0.19 NT$.

Jia Wei's first-half revenue was NT$239.5 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 11.8%, mainly due to the decline in first-quarter revenue. However, with the second-quarter operations gradually recovering, the company's first-half gross margin remained at 35.52%, an increase of 0.27 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit was NT$57 million, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$.

Jia Wei pointed out that the main contribution to the company's first-half performance came from its US subsidiary FDG and the Prepara brand, with FDG showing explosive growth this year, with revenue reaching NT$188 million, an increase of 8 times from the same period last year. At the same time, Prepara also achieved stable performance, with first-half revenue of NT$90 million, a year-on-year increase of 25%, effectively increasing the group's overseas sales channels revenue scale.

Although Jia Wei's 2026 first quarter was affected by production capacity adjustments and cost allocation, the gross margin fell to 34.33%. However, the second quarter has increased to 37.28%, with the company's first-half average gross margin at 35.52%, mainly benefiting from FDG's transformation into an importer trading model, which has contributed to an increase in gross margin, as well as Jia Wei's sales cost structure optimization, which has also contributed to an increase in gross margin, making the company's overall profit structure more refined, and proving that the company has made substantial progress in responding to market challenges and internal strategy adjustments.

Jia Wei announced its July revenue today, with a single-month revenue of NT$2.11 billion, a month-on-month increase of 42.62%, and a year-on-year increase of 1.47%. The company's 1-7 revenue was NT$260.6 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 10.88%.

This week, the US will announce the US July CPI and PPI, with the market expecting a slight easing of inflationary pressure. If the data meets expectations, the Federal Reserve may continue to maintain interest rates unchanged. Although employment data has slowed down, the 6-month retail sales year-on-year growth rate remained at 6.7%, indicating that consumer spending remains stable. Jia Wei faced uncertainty over tariffs last year and actively adjusted its product structure. The company has already shown its effectiveness in the first half of the year and will continue to adjust its pace to respond to changes in the external environment, aiming to achieve better performance in the second half of the year.

items.title_en: Microsoft Seeks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Capacity for Maia 300
paras: 微軟 (MSFT-US) 計劃大幅提高新一代自研人工智慧 (AI) 晶片產量，並爭取 Anthropic 等大型雲端客戶採用，以降低對輝達(NVDA-US)AI 加速器的依賴。
科技媒體《The Information》周一 (10 日) 引述知情人士報導，微軟準備在今年秋季發布新一代 AI 晶片 Maia 300，最快可能於 8 月亮相，正式發布時間則預計落在 9 月。微軟已與台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 洽談產能，希望取得超過 30 萬顆 Maia 300 的製造能力，預計於 2027 年交付。
Maia 300 是微軟自研 AI 加速器系列的升級產品，主要用於滿足 Azure 雲端平台持續成長的 AI 運算需求。報導指出，微軟希望透過擴大產量及導入大型客戶，加速建立自有 AI 晶片生態系。一名微軟主管未評論具體生產計畫，但表示公司最終目標是讓 Maia 晶片的部署規模達到數吉瓦。
不過，微軟目前使用的 Maia 200 市場採用速度仍相對緩慢。儘管公司已投入大量資金開發專用 AI 晶片，客戶轉換既有運算架構及進行大規模部署仍面臨挑戰。
隨著生成式 AI 帶動運算需求急升，大型雲端服務商正加速發展自研晶片，以降低對輝達 GPU 供應鏈的依賴。除微軟之外，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下 Google 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 也已推出自有 AI 晶片，科技巨擘之間的晶片競賽持續升溫。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) plans to significantly increase production of its next-generation self-developed artificial intelligence (AI) chips, and is seeking to win over large cloud customers such as Anthropic to reduce its dependence on NVIDIA (NVDA-US) AI accelerators.

According to a report by The Information on Monday (10th), Microsoft is preparing to release its next-generation AI chip, Maia 300, as early as August, with a formal release planned for September. Microsoft has been in talks with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM-US) (2330-TW) to secure production capacity of over 300,000 Maia 300 units, with delivery expected in 2027.

Maia 300 is an upgraded product in Microsoft's self-developed AI accelerator series, primarily used to meet the growing AI computing demands of the Azure cloud platform. The report states that Microsoft hopes to accelerate the establishment of its own AI chip ecosystem by expanding production and introducing large customers. A Microsoft executive declined to comment on specific production plans, but stated that the company's ultimate goal is to deploy Maia chips at a scale of tens of gigawatts.

However, the adoption rate of Microsoft's current Maia 200 in the market remains relatively slow. Despite investing heavily in developing dedicated AI chips, customers face challenges in transitioning to new computing architectures and deploying them on a large scale.

As generative AI drives up computing demands, large cloud service providers are accelerating the development of self-developed chips to reduce their dependence on NVIDIA's GPU supply chain. In addition to Microsoft, Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) Google and Amazon (AMZN-US) have also launched their own AI chips, and the chip competition between tech giants continues to heat up.

items.title: 統一中國飲品賣不動了 半年報營收近五年來首現下滑
items.title_en: Uni-President China's Sales Slump for the First Time in Five Years
paras: 近日統一企業中國 (00220-HK) 公布 2026 年上半年財報，整體經營保持正增長，但兩大主營業務呈現冷熱分化格局，營收基本盤飲品業務收益回落，近五年首次下滑。
財報顯示，今年上半年統一企業中國整體營收達到人民幣 173.21 億元，較去年同期小幅成長 1.4%，歸母淨利潤 14.02 億元，增加 9%，綜合毛利率優化至 35%。
佔據總營收超過六成的飲品業務，上半年營收為 107.51 億元，較一年前微降 0.3%，結束多年上半年飲品業務持續走高的態勢。財報顯示，飲品業務毛利率上浮 0.5% 至 39.9%。
拆分飲品各細分品類看，傳統含糖瓶裝產品成為主要業績拖累，支柱品類茶飲料上半年營收為 48.89 億元，較去年同期下滑 3.5%，佔飲品整體收入近半數；果汁業務也不好看，營收 17.21 億元，下降幅度達到 5.5%。
曾經佔據線下冰櫃核心位置的冰紅茶、統一綠茶、鮮橙多等經典單品終端銷量放緩，不少經銷商反應常規大瓶裝飲品庫存周轉速度下降。
在全品類整體承壓情況下，奶茶賽道成為增長支點。上半年奶茶業務營收為 36.45 億元，較去年同期成長 7.3%。老牌爆款阿薩姆奶茶銷量保持穩定，低糖茉莉奶綠是奶茶業務全新增長主力，咖啡、包裝水等其餘飲品品類小幅走低。
據《界面新聞》10 日（周一）報導，消費偏好變化、行業環境轉變是統一飲料銷量遇冷的誘因。公開數據表明，2026 年上半年中國規模以上飲料總產量較一年前下滑 0.5%，也是近五年飲料行業首次上半年產量下降，整個瓶裝飲品賽道正式邁入存量博弈階段。
尼爾森 IQ 監測數據顯示，今年 5 月中國飲品全渠道銷售額年降 8.7%，消費者健康化的消費偏好重塑飲品市場格局，無糖茶飲迎來高速擴張，含糖瓶裝茶、常溫果汁受眾持續縮減。
市場多線分流同樣擠壓統一傳統飲品的生存空間，一方面無糖茶飲賽道競品搶先布局市場份額，現製茶飲搶佔年輕群體休閒飲用場景；另一方面零食折扣店、會員商超興起，定製款平價飲品打擊傳統流通渠道。
paras_en: Uni-President China (00220-HK) released its 2026 first-half financial report, showing overall operations maintained positive growth, but two major business segments presented a differentiated pattern, with basic plate beverage business revenue declining, marking the first time in five years.

The report showed that Uni-President China's total revenue reached RMB 173.21 billion in the first half of this year, up 1.4% year-on-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.02 billion, up 9%, and comprehensive gross margin optimized to 35%.

The beverage business, which accounted for more than 60% of total revenue, had a revenue of RMB 107.51 billion in the first half, down 0.3% from a year ago, ending the long-standing trend of continuous growth in the first half of the year. The report showed that the beverage business gross margin rose 0.5% to 39.9%.

Breaking down the beverage business by sub-category, traditional sugared bottled products became the main drag on performance, with the pillar category of tea drinks having a revenue of RMB 48.89 billion in the first half, down 3.5% from a year ago, accounting for nearly half of the total income of the beverage business; the juice business was also not good, with a revenue of RMB 17.21 billion, a decline of 5.5%.

Classic single products such as ice red tea, Uni-President green tea, and fresh orange juice, which once occupied the core position of offline refrigerators, have seen terminal sales slow down, with many distributors reporting that the inventory turnover speed of regular large-bottled drinks has decreased.

In the overall pressure situation of the entire category, the milk tea track became the growth point. The revenue of the milk tea business in the first half was RMB 36.45 billion, up 7.3% from a year ago. The classic bestseller Assam milk tea maintained stable sales, while low-sugar jasmine milk green tea became the main growth driver of the milk tea business, with coffee, packaged water, and other beverage categories experiencing slight declines.

According to a report by Interface News on October 10 (Monday), changes in consumer preferences and changes in the industry environment are the factors that have led to the decline in sales of Uni-President's drinks. Public data shows that China's large-scale beverage production volume in the first half of 2026 decreased by 0.5% compared to the previous year, marking the first time in five years that the beverage industry has seen a decline in production volume in the first half, and the entire bottled drink track has officially entered the inventory competition stage.

Nielsen IQ monitoring data shows that in May this year, China's beverage sales across all channels decreased by 8.7% year-on-year, and consumers' health-conscious consumption preferences reshaped the beverage market landscape, with low-sugar tea drinks experiencing rapid expansion, and sugared bottled tea and regular temperature juice experiencing a continued decline in popularity.

Market multi-channel diversion has also squeezed the survival space of Uni-President's traditional drinks, with one side being the competition for market share by low-sugar tea drink competitors, who have set up shop in the market, and the other side being the rise of discount stores and membership supermarkets, which have launched customized low-priced drinks to attack traditional distribution channels.

items.title: 嘉威雙箭頭展現成效 第二季轉盈推升上半年每股純益0.68元
items.title_en: Jia Wei's Double Arrow Effect: Second Quarter Profit Boosts Half-Year EPS to 0.68 NT$
paras: 雖處於傳統第二季的淡季，但嘉威生活 (3557-TW) 今 (10) 日公布的最新獲利資訊，上半年中，受惠美國子公司 FDG 轉型貿易模式，加上 Prepara 品牌效應，帶動上半年較去年同期轉虧為盈，稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。嘉威營運走出谷底。公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
嘉威 2026 年第二季營運明顯回溫，營收達 9.64 億元，年增 34.6％，同時，FDG 營運模式轉型、品牌 Prepara 持續成長，以及母公司成本結構優化，第二季毛利率提升至 37.28%，季增 2.95 個百分點，年增 7.14 個百分點，稅後純益 1635 萬元，季減 59.81%，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.19 元。
嘉威上半年營收 23.95 億元，年減 11.8%，主要受到第一季營收下滑影響，不過，隨著第二季營運逐步回升，上半年毛利率仍達 35.52%，較去年同期提升 0.27 百分點；稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。
嘉威指出，上半年主要來自於美國子公司 FDG 及品牌 Prepara 的雙重貢獻，FDG 今年展現爆發式成長，營收衝上 1.88 億元，較去年同期成長高達 8 倍。同時，Prepara 也繳出穩健成績，上半年營收 9000 萬元，年增 25%，有效提升集團海外通路營收規模。
儘管 2026 年第一季受產能配置調整與成本分攤拉高的影響，毛利率降至 34.33%，但第二季已提高到 37.28%，上半年整體平均毛利率達 35.52%，主要受益於 FDG 轉型為進口商貿易模式，貢獻毛利率增加，另外，嘉威銷貨成本結構優化，也貢獻毛利率增加，使整體獲利結構精進，也證明公司在應對市場挑戰與內部策略調整上均取得實質進展。
嘉威今天同時公布 7 月營收，單月營收 2.11 億元，月 42.62%，年增 1.47％；2026 年 1-7 營收 26.06 億元，年減 10.88%。
本周美國將公布美國 7 月 CPI 及 PPI，市場預期通膨壓力略有減緩，若數據符合預期，聯準會有望繼續維持利率不變；另外，雖然就業數據放緩，但 6 月零售銷售年增率仍達 6.7%，顯示消費者支出依舊穩健。嘉威去年面對關稅不確定性，積極調整體質結構，上半年已展現成效，公司仍持續調整腳步面對外在環境隨時變化，目標繳出下半年優於上半年的成績。
paras_en: Despite being in the traditional second quarter's off-season, Jia Wei Life (3557-TW) announced its latest profit information today, with the company benefiting from its US subsidiary FDG's transformation of its trading model, as well as the Prepara brand effect, leading to a profit of NT$57 million in the first half of the year, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$. Jia Wei's operations have emerged from the trough.

Jia Wei's 2026 second-quarter operations have clearly rebounded, with revenue reaching NT$964 million, a year-on-year increase of 34.6%. At the same time, FDG's operating model transformation, the continuous growth of the Prepara brand, and the optimization of the parent company's cost structure have led to a second-quarter gross margin of 37.28%, an increase of 2.95 percentage points from the previous quarter and a year-on-year increase of 7.14 percentage points. The company's net profit was NT$163.5 million, a decrease of 59.81% from the previous quarter, but an increase of NT$19 million from the same period last year, with an EPS of 0.19 NT$.

Jia Wei's first-half revenue was NT$239.5 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 11.8%, mainly due to the decline in first-quarter revenue. However, with the second-quarter operations gradually recovering, the company's first-half gross margin remained at 35.52%, an increase of 0.27 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit was NT$57 million, with an EPS of 0.68 NT$.

Jia Wei pointed out that the main contribution to the company's first-half performance came from its US subsidiary FDG and the Prepara brand, with FDG showing explosive growth this year, with revenue reaching NT$188 million, an increase of 8 times from the same period last year. At the same time, Prepara also achieved stable performance, with first-half revenue of NT$90 million, a year-on-year increase of 25%, effectively increasing the group's overseas sales channels revenue scale.

Although Jia Wei's 2026 first quarter was affected by production capacity adjustments and cost allocation, the gross margin fell to 34.33%. However, the second quarter has increased to 37.28%, with the company's first-half average gross margin at 35.52%, mainly benefiting from FDG's transformation into an importer trading model, which has contributed to an increase in gross margin, as well as Jia Wei's sales cost structure optimization, which has also contributed to an increase in gross margin, making the company's overall profit structure more refined, and proving that the company has made substantial progress in responding to market challenges and internal strategy adjustments.

Jia Wei announced its July revenue today, with a single-month revenue of NT$2.11 billion, a month-on-month increase of 42.62%, and a year-on-year increase of 1.47%. The company's 1-7 revenue was NT$260.6 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 10.88%.

This week, the US will announce the US July CPI and PPI, with the market expecting a slight easing of inflationary pressure. If the data meets expectations, the Federal Reserve may continue to maintain interest rates unchanged. Although employment data has slowed down, the 6-month retail sales year-on-year growth rate remained at 6.7%, indicating that consumer spending remains stable. Jia Wei faced uncertainty over tariffs last year and actively adjusted its product structure. The company has already shown its effectiveness in the first half of the year and will continue to adjust its pace to respond to changes in the external environment, aiming to achieve better performance in the second half of the year.

items.title: 上市櫃14檔處置股明起齊被關 愛普*、晶豪科漲很大遭關禁閉至8/17
items.title_en: 14 Stocks Placed on Trading Suspension from August 11 to 17
paras: 處置股新制起正式上路後，證交所及櫃買中心今 (10) 日公告首波 14 檔處置股，包括愛普 * (6531-TW)、聯鈞 (3450-TW)、晶豪科(3006)、大量(3167-TW) 等 9 檔上市股，5 檔上櫃股包括富喬 (3450-TW)、聯亞(3081-TW)、中探針(6217-TW)、鈺創(5351-TW)、IET-KY(4971-TW)。14 檔個股自明(11) 日起至 8 月 17 日列為處置股，股票交易撮合時間調整為每 2 分鐘一次，至 8 月 17 日出關。
9 檔上市股遭列為處置股，包括吉祥全 (2491-TW、晶豪科、大量 (3167-TW)、聯鈞、聯茂 (6213-TW)、訊芯 - KY(6451-TW)、愛普 *、聯友金屬 - 創 (7610-TW)、尖點 (8021-TW)。
晶豪科處置原因為最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 44.48%。且六個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達 77.5 元。
吉祥權處置原因最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 43.86％。
愛普 * 大量處置原因為最近六個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達 33.89%，且六個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達 190 元。
另有 5 檔上櫃股中包括富喬、聯亞、中探針、鈺創及 IET-KY。14 檔個股自 8 月 11 日起至 8 月 17 日列為處置股，交易撮合時間經新制調整後，為每 2 分鐘一次。
愛普 * 在本周召開法說會並公布 7 月營收，不僅釋出未來數年樂觀展望，7 月營收更達 11.04 億元，創下歷史新高，今日股價開高走低，跌 2.94％。愛普 * 公司看好，隨著 IoTRAM 應用市場持續擴展、產品組合將持續優化，在三大產品線成長動能延續，預期未來幾年，營收有望以倍數成長。
記憶體 IC 設計大廠晶豪科則是受惠於記憶體市場供需結構大幅改善及產品價格強勁上揚， 7 月單月營收高達 67.85 億元、月增 40.02%、年增 491.06%，連續刷新單月歷史新高。晶豪科今日在外資連 6 買挹注下，股價也收漲 7.41％。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) and the Taiwan Stock Exchange's over-the-counter (OTC) market announced the first batch of 14 stocks to be placed on trading suspension, including 9 listed stocks and 5 OTC stocks, on August 10.

The 14 stocks to be placed on trading suspension include Epistar Corp (6531-TW), Lianzhong Enterprise Co Ltd (3450-TW), Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW), Daqian Group Co Ltd (3167-TW), and 5 other listed stocks.

Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW) was placed on trading suspension due to a 44.48% increase in its closing price over the past 6 trading days, and a price difference of NT$77.5 between the 6th and 8th trading days.
Jixiang Group Co Ltd (2491-TW) was placed on trading suspension due to a 43.86% increase in its closing price over the past 6 trading days.

Epistar Corp (6531-TW) and Daqian Group Co Ltd (3167-TW) were placed on trading suspension due to a 33.89% increase in their closing prices over the past 6 trading days, and a price difference of NT$190 between the 6th and 8th trading days.

In addition to the 9 listed stocks, 5 OTC stocks, including Fuzhao Enterprise Co Ltd (3450-TW), Lianya Enterprise Co Ltd (3081-TW), Zhongtan Needle Co Ltd (6217-TW), Yuexin Technology Co Ltd (5351-TW), and IET-KY Co Ltd (4971-TW), were also placed on trading suspension.

Epistar Corp (6531-TW) held a conference call on August 10 and announced its July revenue, which reached NT$11.04 billion, a new historical high. The company's stock price opened high and fell 2.94% today.

Jihua Technology Co Ltd (3006-TW) benefited from the significant improvement in the memory market's supply and demand structure and the strong increase in product prices. Its July monthly revenue reached NT$67.85 billion, up 40.02% from the previous month and 491.06% from the same period last year, setting a new historical high. The company's stock price rose 7.41% today, with foreign investors buying for 6 consecutive days.

items.title: PSA華科事業群攜北科大產學合作 聚焦AI技術研發與人才培育兩大面向
items.title_en: PSA Huake Business Group Partners with National Taipei University of Technology for Industry-Academia Collaboration, Focusing on AI R&D and Talent Development
paras: PSA 華科事業群與國立臺北科技大學今 (10) 日簽署產學合作計畫，共同宣布啟動為期三年、總投入 5,000 萬元的合作案，預計自 2026 年第四季正式展開，將聚焦 AI 技術研發與人才培育兩大面向。
簽約儀式由 PSA 華科事業群董事長焦佑衡與國立臺北科技大學校長任貽均共同代表簽署，教育部次長劉國偉應邀出席見證，象徵產官學攜手推動 AI 技術研發與人才培育，共同深化產學合作。
焦佑衡致詞時表示，台灣出生率持續下降，人才培育已成為企業永續發展的重要課題，AI 正快速改變全球產業發展模式，企業競爭力除了來自技術創新，更取決於人才的培育與累積，而台灣擁有優良的大學教育、安全的社會環境、健全的醫療體系，以及完整的科技產業鏈，具備吸引國際人才來台發展的優勢。
焦佑衡指出，企業除了提供具競爭力的薪資與良好的發展環境，也應持續投入人才培育，吸引優秀人才留在台灣、在台灣發展，此次與北科大合作希望整合雙方資源，提早培育具備專業能力、國際視野及實作經驗的人才，讓優秀人才與企業共同成長，並將科技創新的力量回饋產業與社會。
任貽均表示，北科大與 PSA 華科事業群合作淵源深厚，自 2018 年華新科加入北科大國際產學聯盟以來，雙方持續推動產學合作，2019 年更攜手將工業 4.0 智慧製造技術導入 PSA 馬來西亞生產基地，奠定良好的合作基礎，此次合作將進一步深化 AI 技術研發與人才培育，攜手打造產學共創新典範。
華科事業群長期深耕被動元件、PCB、EMS、能源及半導體封裝測試等領域，產品應用相當多元，從日常生活、AI 伺服器，到醫療 MRI 設備、日本新幹線等領域，近年更積極推動 AI 技術導入智慧製造、研發設計及營運管理。
此次與北科大的產學合作，參與企業包含華新科、華東、瀚宇博、精成科、佳邦等，雙方以華科事業群 AI 專案需求為出發點，共同推動 AI 相關技術研究與應用開發，促進創新技術落地，提升企業智慧製造、研發及營運效率，並透過完善的產學合作機制，培養未來所需的專業技術人才，建立從校園到職場的接軌機制。
paras_en: PSA Huake Business Group and National Taipei University of Technology signed an industry-academia cooperation plan today (the 10th), announcing the launch of a three-year collaboration with a total investment of NT$50 million, scheduled to commence in the fourth quarter of 2026, focusing on AI technology research and development as well as talent cultivation.

The signing ceremony was attended by PSA Huake Business Group Chairman Jiao Youheng and NTUT President Ren Yijun, who signed on behalf of their organizations, with Deputy Minister of Education Liu Guowei invited to witness the event, symbolizing the joint effort of industry, government, and academia to promote AI technology R&D and talent development and deepen industry‑academia cooperation.

In his remarks, Jiao Youheng noted that Taiwan's birth rate continues to decline, making talent cultivation a critical issue for corporate sustainability. AI is rapidly reshaping global industry development models, and a company's competitiveness depends not only on technological innovation but also on the training and accumulation of talent. He highlighted Taiwan's strengths—high‑quality university education, a safe social environment, a robust healthcare system, and a complete technology industry chain—as advantages for attracting international talent to develop in Taiwan.

Jiao emphasized that companies should not only offer competitive salaries and a good development environment but also continuously invest in talent cultivation to retain top talent in Taiwan. The partnership with NTUT aims to integrate resources from both sides to nurture professionals with expertise, international perspective, and hands‑on experience early on, allowing outstanding talent and enterprises to grow together and channel the power of technological innovation back to industry and society.

Ren Yijun said that the cooperation between NTUT and PSA Huake Business Group has deep roots. Since Huaxin Ke joined NTUT’s International Industry‑Academia Alliance in 2018, the two sides have continuously promoted collaboration, and in 2019 they jointly introduced Industry 4.0 smart manufacturing technology to PSA’s production base in Malaysia, laying a solid foundation. This new partnership will further deepen AI technology R&D and talent cultivation, jointly creating a new model of industry‑academia co‑innovation.

Huake Business Group has long been engaged in passive components, PCBs, EMS, energy, and semiconductor packaging and testing, with a diverse range of product applications—from everyday life and AI servers to medical MRI equipment and Japan’s Shinkansen. In recent years, the group has actively promoted the integration of AI technology into smart manufacturing, R&D design, and operational management.

The industry‑academia collaboration with NTUT involves companies such as Huaxin Ke, Huadong, Hanyu Bo, Jingcheng Ke, and Jiabang. Starting from the AI project needs of the Huake Business Group, both sides will jointly advance AI‑related technology research and application development, facilitating the implementation of innovative technologies, enhancing smart manufacturing, R&D, and operational efficiency, and through a comprehensive cooperation mechanism, cultivate the professional technical talent needed for the future, establishing a seamless pipeline from campus to the workplace.

items.title: 資產處分活化、油品雙引擎挹注  北基上半年EPS 0.62元已賺贏去年全年
items.title_en: Asset Disposal Boosts, Oil Product Dual-Engine Injection: North Base's First Half EPS 0.62 Yuan Already Surpassed Last Year's Full-Year
paras: 北基 (8927-TW) 今 (10) 日公告自結今年上半年財報及 7 月營收，北基上半年受惠資產活化策略持續發揮效益，稅後純益為 2.63 億元、年增 8.14 倍，每股稅後盈餘達 0.62 元，不僅較去 (2025) 年同期大幅成長，更已超越去年全年度獲利，也創歷年同期次高記錄，
北基上半年合併營收達 76.37 億元、年增 51.11％，改寫歷年同期新高；稅後純益為 2.63 億元、年增 8.14 倍；毛利率為 16％、年減 0.4 個百分比；營業利益率年增約 2.1 個百分比。
北基指出，上半年獲利大幅躍升，主要受惠土地建設事業資產活化策略持續發揮效益，包括出售高雄市鼓山區龍中段、高雄市三民區澄東段及桃園市三民段、台南市安平區國安段等營建用地，帶動上半年土地建設業務營收比重較去年同期的 12％攀升至 37％。
其次，旗下核心油品事業銷售亦同步年增 9.3％，因集團於全台加油站覆蓋率持續提升，挹注發油量年增約 1.14％，加上國際油價上漲，帶動上半年平均油價明顯高於去年同期，隨著整體業務組合結構調整，優化集團整體營運效率。
此外，北基也自結 7 月營收為 8.38 億元、月減 39.8％、年增 6.55％，創歷年同期次高。北基表示，7 月因土地處分案認列時點不若上半年密集而較上月下滑，累計今年 1 至 7 月合併營收達 84.75 億元、年增 45.43％，續創歷年同期新高。
展望今年第三季，北基表示，將持審慎樂觀看法，油品事業仍為集團核心營運基礎，隨著暑期用油需求、民生消費活動及車流回升，持續透過站點營運效率提升、服務品質優化及據點布局精進，穩固油品銷售表現，同時集團亦將持續推進光電綠能、土地建設資產活化等多元事業布局，深化集團多角化經營利基，並創造未來營運良好動能。
paras_en: North Base (8927-TW) announced today (10) that it has concluded its first-half financial report and July revenue. North Base's first-half performance benefited from the continued effectiveness of its asset activation strategy, with a net profit of NT$26.3 billion, an 8.14-fold increase from the same period last year, and a net profit per share of NT$0.62, surpassing last year's full-year profit and setting a record for the second-highest in history.

North Base's first-half consolidated revenue reached NT$763.7 billion, a 51.11% increase from the same period last year, setting a new high. The net profit was NT$26.3 billion, an 8.14-fold increase from the same period last year. The gross margin was 16%, a 0.4 percentage point decrease from the same period last year, and the operating profit margin increased by approximately 2.1 percentage points.

North Base pointed out that the significant increase in profits in the first half was mainly due to the continued effectiveness of the asset activation strategy in the land development business, including the sale of land in Kaohsiung City's Gushan District, Kaohsiung City's Sanmin District, Taoyuan City's Sanmin District, and Tainan City's Anping District, which drove the land development business revenue to increase by 37% compared to the same period last year.

Secondly, the core oil product business of the company also saw a 9.3% increase in sales, as the group's coverage rate of gas stations across Taiwan continued to improve, injecting an increase of approximately 1.14% in fuel sales, and with the international oil price rising, the average oil price in the first half was significantly higher than the same period last year. With the overall business structure adjustment and optimization of the group's overall operating efficiency.

In addition, North Base also announced that its July revenue was NT$838 million, a 39.8% decrease from the previous month and a 6.55% increase from the same period last year, setting a record for the second-highest in history. North Base stated that the 7th month was due to the recognition of land disposal cases at a slower pace than the first half, resulting in a decline from the previous month, and the cumulative revenue from January to July was NT$847.5 billion, a 45.43% increase from the same period last year, setting a new high.

Looking ahead to the third quarter, North Base stated that it will maintain a cautious and optimistic view, with the oil product business remaining the core operating foundation of the group. With the increase in summer fuel demand, consumer spending, and traffic flow, the group will continue to improve station operating efficiency, service quality, and site layout, to stabilize oil sales performance, while also continuing to promote diversified business layouts such as solar energy, green energy, and land development asset activation, to deepen the group's multi-industry operation and create future operating momentum.

items.title: 不想讓OpenAI等巨頭壟斷AI！祖克柏開放Meta最強模型
items.title_en: Don't Let Giants Like OpenAI Monopolize AI! Zuckerberg Opens Meta's Strongest Model
paras: Meta Platforms(META-US)宣布將開放旗下最強人工智慧 (AI) 模型的權重，並推出可直接在消費性裝置運行的新模型，藉此挑戰 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 等採取封閉模式的領先 AI 實驗室。Meta 周一盤前上漲 2.1%。
執行長祖克柏 (Mark Zuckerberg) 周一 (10 日) 透過 Instagram 影片表示，Meta 將開放最新 AI 模型 Muse Spark 1.2 的權重，允許大眾下載及使用。模型權重是決定 AI 如何運作與回應的一系列參數與規則。
Meta 也將推出名為 Muse Glimmer 的全新開放模型系列，主要特色是能直接在筆記型電腦上運行，不必完全依賴昂貴的雲端資料中心。

Meta 押注開放權重 挑戰中國 AI 模型

OpenAI 及 Anthropic 主要採用封閉模型，但阿里巴巴 (BABA-US)(09988-HK)、深度求索(DeepSeek) 及月之暗面 (Moonshot) 等中國業者近年積極推出開放權重模型，部分產品的能力已足以與美國領先技術競爭。
祖克柏周一發表一篇長達 6,500 字的 AI 文章，將 Meta 的行動定位為美國對中國開放 AI 技術的反擊，並呼籲華府降低美國業者開發開放模型時面臨的政策障礙。
他表示，外國 AI 實驗室目前擁有多項優勢，原因是美國業者在訓練資料方面必須遵守更多限制。若美國希望其開放模型長期保持領先，政策就必須降低這些額外摩擦。
祖克柏反對限制取得外國開放模型，認為美國真正的目標應是打造全球最優秀的開放模型，而非阻止開發者使用中國技術。
Counterpoint Research 共同創辦人 Neil Shah 指出，如果西方科技巨擘只建立封閉的「圍牆花園」，開發者及企業自然會轉向中國開放權重模型。由於美國多數競爭對手仍採封閉策略，市場對非中國開放模型存在龐大需求，Meta 有機會填補這項空缺。
Muse Glimmer 的裝置端設計也成為 Meta 與其他業者區隔的重要特點。目前多數 AI 服務均由雲端資料中心處理，直接在個人電腦或手機上運行，則可降低雲端運算成本、縮短回應時間，並可能協助 Meta 在終端裝置上挑戰 Google 及微軟。

暗批 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 反對 AI 權力集中

祖克柏表示，美國若想在開放 AI 領域取得領導地位，就必須重新檢討模型蒸餾及訓練資料使用等政策。模型蒸餾通常是利用先進模型的輸出訓練另一個模型，但部分美國議員認為，這種做法可能涉及竊取智慧財產權。
祖克柏也警告，不應將 AI 能力集中在少數企業手中，相關言論被視為暗批 OpenAI 及 Anthropic。他質疑，如果有人認為 AI 將消滅多數工作、削弱人類的重要性，為何仍急於打造這樣的未來；宣稱 AI 太危險，因此只能將權力極度集中，同樣存在根本問題。
Anthropic 執行長阿莫戴 (Dario Amodei) 及 OpenAI 執行長阿特曼 (Sam Altman) 過去均曾警告 AI 對就業的衝擊，儘管 Altman 近期已稍微淡化相關說法。
祖克柏主張，與其集中超級智慧，更應廣泛分配 AI 能力，讓每個人都能掌握並運用。他預期，未來每個人都將擁有能力極強的個人 AI 代理，理解使用者、個人目標及其重視的一切。
Meta 今年資本支出預估最高達 1,450 億美元，股價今年來仍下跌約 10%。在投資人持續檢視龐大 AI 支出及競爭能力之際，祖克柏正試圖證明去年成立的 Meta 超級智慧實驗室已取得進展，相關投資最終能帶來回報。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) announced it will open the weights of its most powerful artificial intelligence (AI) model and launch a new model that can run directly on consumer devices, aiming to challenge leading AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic that use closed approaches. Meta rose 2.1% pre‑market on Monday.

CEO Mark Zuckerberg said in an Instagram video on Monday (the 10th) that Meta will release the weights of its latest AI model Muse Spark 1.2, allowing the public to download and use them. Model weights are the set of parameters and rules that determine how the AI operates and responds.
Meta will also roll out a brand‑new open‑model series called Muse Glimmer, whose main feature is the ability to run directly on laptops without relying entirely on expensive cloud data centers.

Meta bets on open weights to challenge Chinese AI models. While OpenAI and Anthropic mainly use closed models, Chinese players such as Alibaba (BABA-US)(09988‑HK), DeepSeek and Moonshot have recently been active in releasing open‑weight models, with some products already competitive with leading U.S. technology.

Zuckerberg published a 6,500‑word article on Monday positioning Meta’s move as a U.S. counter‑offensive to China’s open AI efforts and urging Washington to lower policy barriers that U.S. firms face when developing open models.

He noted that foreign AI labs currently enjoy several advantages because U.S. companies must comply with more restrictions on training data. If the U.S. wants its open models to stay ahead in the long run, policy must reduce these extra frictions.

Zuckerberg opposes limiting access to foreign open models, arguing that America’s real goal should be to build the world’s best open model rather than prevent developers from using Chinese technology.

Neil Shah, co‑founder of Counterpoint Research, warned that if Western tech giants only build closed “walled gardens,” developers and enterprises will naturally turn to Chinese open‑weight models. Because most U.S. competitors remain closed, there is huge demand for non‑Chinese open models, giving Meta an opportunity to fill that gap.

The device‑side design of Muse Glimmer is also a key differentiator for Meta versus other players. Most AI services today run in cloud data centers; running directly on a personal computer or phone can cut cloud‑computing costs, shorten response times, and potentially help Meta challenge Google and Microsoft on the endpoint.

Zuckerberg subtly criticized OpenAI and Anthropic for opposing AI power concentration. He said the U.S. must revisit policies on model distillation and training‑data use if it wants to lead in open AI. Model distillation—training a new model on the outputs of a more advanced one—has been flagged by some U.S. lawmakers as potentially infringing intellectual‑property rights.

He also warned that AI capabilities should not be concentrated in a few companies, a comment seen as a veiled jab at OpenAI and Anthropic. He questioned why anyone would rush to build a future where AI eliminates most jobs and diminishes human importance, then claim AI is too dangerous and therefore must be tightly controlled, calling that a fundamental problem.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman have both warned about AI’s impact on employment, although Altman has recently softened his rhetoric.

Zuckerberg argues that instead of concentrating superintelligence, AI capability should be widely distributed so everyone can harness it. He envisions a future where each person has a highly capable personal AI agent that understands the user, personal goals, and what matters to them.

Meta’s capital expenditures this year are projected to top $145 billion, and its stock is down about 10% year‑to‑date. As investors continue to scrutinize massive AI spending and competitive positioning, Zuckerberg is trying to prove that the Meta Superintelligence Lab, founded last year, is making progress and that the investment will ultimately pay off.

items.title: 不只賣比特幣還賣股票 Strategy一周套現逾7億美元
items.title_en: Strategy Sells Over $700 Million in Bitcoin and Stocks in One Week
paras: 塞勒 (Michael Saylor) 旗下 Strategy(MSTR-US)持續調整資本結構，上周同步出售比特幣與普通股，以擴充現金儲備並回購特別股。
Strategy 周一 (10 日) 表示，截至 8 月 9 日止的七天內，公司出售價值 1.086 億美元的比特幣，並賣出 660 萬股普通股，籌得約 6.53 億美元；同時斥資 1.086 億美元回購代號 STRC、名為 Stretch 的特別股。目前 Strategy 持有的比特幣總值約 580 億美元，仍是全球持有比特幣最多的上市公司。
Strategy 過去憑藉長期大量買進比特幣而聲名大噪，但隨著市場對其融資模式及股權稀釋風險的疑慮升高，塞勒自 5 月底將策略重心轉向資本管理。此後，公司已累計出售約 4.32 億美元比特幣，並將現金儲備提高至約 46 億美元。
為緩解投資人對普通股遭稀釋的擔憂，Saylor 先前曾試圖將發行 STRC 特別股作為公司主要融資來源。然而，STRC 自 5 月初以來一直未能站上 100 美元面額，導致公司難以透過發行該證券有效募資，目前市價約為 95 美元。
Strategy 原本是一家企業軟體公司，後來轉型為比特幣囤積者。身兼共同創辦人及執行董事長的塞勒過去曾鼓勵投資人想盡辦法買進比特幣，如今卻為強化財務韌性而持續賣幣，顯示公司的資本策略正出現明顯轉變。
paras_en: Michael Saylor's Strategy (MSTR-US) continues to adjust its capital structure, selling both Bitcoin and common stock last week to expand its cash reserves and repurchase its special stock.

Strategy announced on Monday (10th) that within the seven days ending August 9, the company sold Bitcoin worth $1.086 billion and sold 6.6 million common shares, raising approximately $653 million; simultaneously, it invested $1.086 billion to repurchase its special stock, designated as STRC, named Stretch.

Strategy previously gained attention for its long-term large-scale purchases of Bitcoin, but as concerns about its financing model and equity dilution risks increased, Saylor shifted the company's strategy to capital management from the end of May.

To alleviate investor concerns about common stock dilution, Saylor previously attempted to use the issuance of STRC special stock as the company's primary source of financing. However, STRC has not exceeded $100 since May 1, making it difficult for the company to effectively raise capital through the issuance of that security, currently trading at around $95.

Originally a corporate software company, Strategy later transformed into a Bitcoin hoarder. As both co-founder and executive chairman, Saylor previously encouraged investors to buy Bitcoin at all costs, but now continues to sell Bitcoin to strengthen its financial resilience, indicating a significant shift in the company's capital strategy.

items.title: 560億美元收購喊卡？GameStop擬改與eBay合作
items.title_en: US$56 billion acquisition called off? GameStop plans to shift to partnership with eBay
paras: 外媒周一 (10 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，由執行長柯恩 (Ryan Cohen) 領導的 GameStop(GME-US) 正考慮撤回對 eBay(EBAY-US) 提出的 560 億美元收購案，轉而尋求建立合作夥伴關係或合資企業。
消息人士指出，柯恩可能提議讓 eBay 運用 GameStop 在美國約 1,600 家實體門市，協助雙方擴大在交換卡片及收藏品等高毛利商品市場的市占率。GameStop 身為 eBay 主要股東之一，也將在合作案中尋求取得 eBay 董事會席次。
GameStop 今年 5 月向 eBay 提出每股 125 美元的收購價，其中 50% 以現金支付，另外 50% 則以 GameStop 普通股支付。不過，自收購案提出以來，GameStop 股價已下跌 28%，eBay 股價則上漲 7.6%，使原本以股票支付的部分吸引力下降。
eBay 上周五收在 111.98 美元，市值約 498 億美元；若計入債務，企業價值接近 540 億美元。知情人士強調，GameStop 尚未做出最終決定，柯恩仍可能評估其他方案。兩家公司均未立即回應置評要求。
這項收購提案原本是 Cohen 在 GameStop 建立 eBay 約 5% 持股後採取的大膽行動。GameStop 隨後持續加碼，截至 7 月 15 日持股比率已升至 9.75%，成為 eBay 第二大股東，持股規模僅次於 Vanguard Group 旗下基金。
儘管 GameStop 目前持有 84 億美元現金，可用於支持潛在交易，但其市值已降至約 86 億美元，遠低於 eBay。知名投資人貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 先前也因擔心 GameStop 可能為收購案背負龐大債務，在提案公布後出清全部持股。
GameStop 過去以電玩實體零售店為主，但隨著玩家轉向線上購買遊戲，公司已大幅縮減門市規模，並嘗試轉型。該公司 2021 年曾成為散戶投機熱潮的核心標的。
eBay 近年雖面臨消費習慣改變及成長放緩等挑戰，但其平台每年商品交易額仍約 800 億美元。截至 3 月 31 日止的 12 個月內，全球約有 1.36 億名消費者曾在 eBay 平台購物。
paras_en: Foreign media on Monday (the 10th) citing sources reported that GameStop (GME-US) led by CEO Ryan Cohen is considering withdrawing its $56 billion acquisition offer for eBay (EBAY-US) and instead seeking to establish a partnership or joint venture.

Sources say Cohen may propose that eBay use GameStop’s roughly 1,600 physical stores in the United States to help both parties increase market share in high‑margin goods such as trading cards and collectibles. As one of eBay’s major shareholders, GameStop would also seek a seat on eBay’s board in the cooperation.

In May this year GameStop offered eBay $125 per share, half in cash and half in GameStop common stock. However, since the bid was announced, GameStop’s share price has fallen 28%, while eBay’s has risen 7.6%, reducing the attractiveness of the stock‑based portion.

eBay closed last Friday at $111.98, giving it a market cap of about $49.8 billion; including debt, enterprise value is close to $54 billion. Sources stress that GameStop has not made a final decision and Cohen may still evaluate other options. Neither company responded immediately to requests for comment.

The acquisition proposal was originally a bold move by Cohen after building roughly a 5% stake in eBay through GameStop. GameStop then continued to increase its holding, reaching 9.75% as of July 15, making it eBay’s second‑largest shareholder behind Vanguard Group funds.

Although GameStop currently holds $8.4 billion in cash that could fund a potential deal, its market value has slipped to about $8.6 billion, far below eBay’s. Prominent investor Michael Burry previously sold all his shares after the proposal, fearing GameStop might take on massive debt from the acquisition.

GameStop historically operated physical video‑game retail stores, but as gamers shifted to online purchases the company has dramatically reduced its store footprint and is trying to transform. The firm was a core target of the retail‑investor frenzy in 2021.

eBay has faced challenges in recent years from changing consumer habits and slowing growth, yet its platform still processes roughly $80 billion in gross merchandise volume annually. In the twelve months ended March 31, about 136 million consumers worldwide shopped on eBay.

items.title: 不想再看輝達臉色！微軟向台積電要產能 Maia 300大舉擴產
items.title_en: Microsoft Seeks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Capacity for Maia 300
paras: 微軟 (MSFT-US) 計劃大幅提高新一代自研人工智慧 (AI) 晶片產量，並爭取 Anthropic 等大型雲端客戶採用，以降低對輝達(NVDA-US)AI 加速器的依賴。
科技媒體《The Information》周一 (10 日) 引述知情人士報導，微軟準備在今年秋季發布新一代 AI 晶片 Maia 300，最快可能於 8 月亮相，正式發布時間則預計落在 9 月。微軟已與台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 洽談產能，希望取得超過 30 萬顆 Maia 300 的製造能力，預計於 2027 年交付。
Maia 300 是微軟自研 AI 加速器系列的升級產品，主要用於滿足 Azure 雲端平台持續成長的 AI 運算需求。報導指出，微軟希望透過擴大產量及導入大型客戶，加速建立自有 AI 晶片生態系。一名微軟主管未評論具體生產計畫，但表示公司最終目標是讓 Maia 晶片的部署規模達到數吉瓦。
不過，微軟目前使用的 Maia 200 市場採用速度仍相對緩慢。儘管公司已投入大量資金開發專用 AI 晶片，客戶轉換既有運算架構及進行大規模部署仍面臨挑戰。
隨著生成式 AI 帶動運算需求急升，大型雲端服務商正加速發展自研晶片，以降低對輝達 GPU 供應鏈的依賴。除微軟之外，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下 Google 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 也已推出自有 AI 晶片，科技巨擘之間的晶片競賽持續升溫。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) plans to significantly increase production of its next-generation self-developed artificial intelligence (AI) chips, and is seeking to win over large cloud customers such as Anthropic to reduce its dependence on NVIDIA (NVDA-US) AI accelerators.

According to a report by The Information on Monday (10th), Microsoft is preparing to release its next-generation AI chip, Maia 300, as early as August, with a formal release planned for September. Microsoft has been in talks with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM-US) (2330-TW) to secure production capacity of over 300,000 Maia 300 units, with delivery expected in 2027.

Maia 300 is an upgraded product in Microsoft's self-developed AI accelerator series, primarily used to meet the growing AI computing demands of the Azure cloud platform. The report states that Microsoft hopes to accelerate the establishment of its own AI chip ecosystem by expanding production and introducing large customers. A Microsoft executive declined to comment on specific production plans, but stated that the company's ultimate goal is to deploy Maia chips at a scale of tens of gigawatts.

However, the adoption rate of Microsoft's current Maia 200 in the market remains relatively slow. Despite investing heavily in developing dedicated AI chips, customers face challenges in transitioning to new computing architectures and deploying them on a large scale.

As generative AI drives up computing demands, large cloud service providers are accelerating the development of self-developed chips to reduce their dependence on NVIDIA's GPU supply chain. In addition to Microsoft, Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) Google and Amazon (AMZN-US) have also launched their own AI chips, and the chip competition between tech giants continues to heat up.

paras: 美股主要指數周一 (10 日) 開盤變動不大，標普 500 指數在創下歷史新高後於平盤附近震盪。美國與伊朗短期內達成持久協議的希望降溫，加上荷姆茲海峽恢復通航仍未取得進展，推升布蘭特原油至每桶 85 美元。
能源成本走高加劇通膨疑慮，市場擔心即使就業市場近期降溫，Fed 今年仍可能升息，帶動美國公債殖利率及美元上揚。本周多項關鍵通膨數據與企業財報公布前，投資人態度轉趨謹慎；個股方面，英特爾 (INTC-US) 宣布發股募資後走低。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌逾 70 點或近 0.1%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近 80 點或 近 0.3%，標普 500 指數跌近 0.1%，費城半導體指數跌近 1.0%。台積電 ADR 跌 0.7%。
美股期指周一在歷史高點附近震盪，投資人一方面等待本周公布的美國消費者物價指數 (CPI)，另一方面持續關注荷姆茲海峽恢復通航的談判進展。由於伊朗與阿曼尚未達成協議，國際油價維持在每桶 84 美元以上。
標普 500 指數上周五收在歷史新高後，美股期指顯示周一開盤波動可能有限。美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 2 個基點至 4.66%，美元兌多數十國集團 (G10) 貨幣小幅走高。
隨著企業財報季大致告一段落，市場焦點重新轉向地緣政治及通膨。AcomeA Sgr 投資組合經理 Fabio Caldato 表示，伊朗局勢對油價及通膨預期的影響，可能再度成為市場主軸，周三公布的美國 CPI 將是檢驗通膨降溫趨勢的重要關卡。
由於伊朗與阿曼仍未就荷姆茲海峽航線達成協議，油價一度上漲 1.7%。與此同時，也門胡塞武裝宣稱攻擊紅海附近的一座沙國煉油廠，進一步加劇能源供應疑慮。
伊朗外交部長阿拉奇 (Abbas Araghchi) 周末表示，伊朗與阿曼就建立荷姆茲海峽航運路線達成協議已「非常接近」。不過，他以美方違反 6 月達成的臨時和平協議為由，排除現階段與美國直接談判的可能。
匯市方面，近期干預措施對日元的提振效果逐漸消退。日圓兌美元周一貶值 0.7%，報 158.84 日元，交易員正警戒日本與美國可能再度採取官方行動。《彭博》策略師指出，日元是 8 月以來唯一兌美元走貶的 G10 貨幣，隨著投資人重新建立日元空頭部位，再次干預匯市的風險也隨之升高。
儘管宏觀不確定性仍高，華爾街對美股前景依舊樂觀。摩根大通將標普 500 年底目標價由 7,800 點上調至 8,000 點，理由是企業財報強勁，加上大型雲端服務業者的人工智慧 (AI) 變現速度快於預期，帶動獲利預估上升。
摩根大通指出，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 及微軟 (MSFT-US) 的雲端業務成長加速，未完成訂單持續增加，可望緩解市場對 AI 資本支出回報的疑慮。隨著積壓訂單逐步轉化為營收，雲端成長將獲得支撐，也有助證明科技巨擘擴大 AI 投資的合理性。
花旗、德意志銀行及高盛同樣名列今年最看多美股的華爾街機構。市場目前平均預估標普 500 年底將升至 7,845 點，較現有水準約高 1%。

items.title: 輝達擬砸30億美元投資Stargate供應鏈Lancium，布局AI資料中心電力
items.title_en: NVIDIA to Invest Up to $3 Billion in Lancium for Stargate Power Supply
paras: 2026年08月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 據《The Information》報導，輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)計畫向電力基礎設施開發商Lancium LLC投資最高30億美元。Lancium由私募股權巨頭Blackstone支持，也是大型AI基礎設施計畫「星際之門Stargate」的電力供應鏈成員，市場認為，輝達希望透過這筆投資掌握更多電力資源，支援AI資料中心客戶持續擴建。
這筆投資將分階段進行。輝達會先投入20億美元，取得Lancium 20%股權，之後視Lancium擴建電力設施的進度，最多再投入10億美元。
交易完成後，Lancium的企業價值估計達100億美元，這項估值包含輝達投入的資金以及Lancium現有債務。
隨著AI資料中心快速擴建，電力供應已成為產業發展關鍵。Lancium本身就是「星際之門Stargate」供應鏈成員，輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)此次投資Lancium，也等於從電力基礎設施端進一步支持Stargate擴建。
Lancium LLC成立於2017年，總部位於美國德州，主要鎖定大型AI資料中心所需的電力基礎設施。與一般資料中心業者不同，Lancium主要負責取得土地、電網接入容量及建置能源基礎設施，再由合作夥伴負責興建及營運資料中心。
Lancium目前已在德州取得並開發約4 GW電力容量，另有15 GW正在等待接入電網。對AI資料中心業者而言，由於大型資料中心從取得土地、接入電網到正式供電往往需要較長時間，因此能否提前掌握電力容量，已成為AI基礎設施擴張的重要條件。
Lancium目前也是大型AI基礎設施計畫「星際之門Stargate」的供應鏈成員。位於德州Abilene的Lancium Clean Campus是Stargate首批重要據點之一，合作夥伴Crusoe持續在當地擴建AI資料中心，規劃在德州Childress開發1 GW AI資料中心園區。

paras_en: August 10, 2026 (Opt Analytics/Industry Data Center Report) - NVIDIA (NVDA-US) plans to invest up to $3 billion in Lancium LLC, a power infrastructure developer, according to a report by The Information. Lancium is backed by private equity giant Blackstone and is a member of the power supply chain for the large-scale AI infrastructure project Stargate.

The investment will be made in stages. NVIDIA will first invest $2 billion for a 20% stake in Lancium, and then may invest up to $1 billion more depending on Lancium's progress in expanding its power infrastructure.
After the deal is completed, Lancium's enterprise value is estimated to be $10 billion, which includes the investment from NVIDIA and Lancium's existing debt.

As AI data centers rapidly expand, power supply has become a critical factor in the industry's development. Lancium itself is a member of the Stargate supply chain, and NVIDIA's investment in Lancium is equivalent to further supporting Stargate's expansion from the power infrastructure end.

Lancium LLC was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Texas, USA. It primarily focuses on developing power infrastructure for large-scale AI data centers. Unlike general data center operators, Lancium is responsible for acquiring land, securing power grid connections, and building energy infrastructure, while its partners handle the construction and operation of data centers.

Lancium currently has approximately 4 GW of power capacity developed in Texas and has another 15 GW waiting to be connected to the grid. For AI data center operators, securing power capacity in advance has become an important condition for expanding AI infrastructure.

Lancium is also a member of the Stargate supply chain. The Lancium Clean Campus in Abilene, Texas, is one of the first key locations for Stargate, and its partner Crusoe is continuously expanding AI data centers in the area. The company plans to develop a 1 GW AI data center park in Childress, Texas.

items.title: 英特爾趁股價翻倍啟動150億美元募資 擴大晶圓代工與先進封裝投資
items.title_en: Intel to Raise $15 Billion in Stock Offering Amid Surging Share Price
paras: 2026年08月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國晶片大廠英特爾Intel(INTC-US)周一宣布，計畫透過發行股票籌集150億美元資金。隨著公司轉型策略帶動今年股價大幅上漲，英特爾選擇把握股價走強時機籌措資金，以支應資本密集度高的晶圓代工業務擴張。
英特爾過去曾是全球晶片產業的主導廠商，但近年面臨競爭加劇，公司正投入大量資金興建新廠，並強化先進封裝能力，希望擴大晶圓代工市場版圖，與產業龍頭台積電(2330-TW)競爭。
受到新股發行可能稀釋既有股東持股的疑慮影響，英特爾周一盤前股價下跌超過3%。不過，在轉型題材推動下，英特爾今年以來股價已上漲超過一倍，表現優於同業，也為公司此時進行大規模股權募資提供有利條件。
根據募資規劃，英特爾將允許承銷商在未來30天內，視市場需求額外購買最多22.5億美元的英特爾股票。如果市場認購反應熱絡、承銷商全數行使這項權利，英特爾最終透過此次股票發行籌集的資金規模，最高募資金額可達172.5億美元。
英特爾Intel先前預期2026年資本支出約與2025年持平，但隨著AI帶動CPU需求升溫，訂單已超過現有製造產能，公司因此在7月將2026年資本支出預估從180億上調至200億美元，加快擴充產能。
相較之下，此次基本募資規模已接近公司一整年的資本支出，對現有股東來說，大規模發行新股將增加流通在外股數，在其他條件不變下，將對每股盈餘帶來稀釋壓力；但從另一個角度來看，公司積極募資，也代表英特爾正在為後續投資預先準備資金，市場將關注這是否反映公司對未來訂單能見度更有信心，並可能進一步上修資本支出、加快擴產腳步。
英特爾近年持續增加新製程、晶圓廠設備與先進封裝相關投資，希望透過擴充製造能力重新建立競爭優勢。今年股價大幅反彈，也讓公司得以把握股價走高的機會，透過資本市場籌措更多資金，降低大規模擴產對自身現金部位帶來的壓力。

paras_en: On August 10, 2026, Intel (INTC-US), a US chip giant, announced plans to raise $15 billion through a stock offering. With the company's transformation strategy driving a significant surge in its stock price this year, Intel is taking advantage of the strong market to raise funds for its capital-intensive foundry business expansion.

Intel, once the dominant player in the global chip industry, has faced increasing competition in recent years. The company is investing heavily in building new factories and strengthening its advanced packaging capabilities to expand its foundry market share and compete with industry leader TSMC (2330-TW).

Intel's stock price fell by over 3% in pre-market trading on Monday due to concerns that the new stock offering might dilute existing shareholders' holdings. However, driven by its transformation, Intel's stock price has more than doubled this year, outperforming its peers and providing favorable conditions for the company's large-scale equity financing.

According to the fundraising plan, Intel will allow underwriters to purchase an additional $2.25 billion of its stock within the next 30 days, depending on market demand. If the market response is strong and the underwriters exercise this option in full, Intel's total fundraising amount could reach $17.25 billion.

Intel had previously expected its 2026 capital expenditures to be similar to those in 2025. However, with AI-driven CPU demand heating up, orders have exceeded current manufacturing capacity, prompting the company to revise its 2026 capital expenditure estimate from $18 billion to $20 billion in July to accelerate capacity expansion.

In comparison, the basic fundraising amount is close to the company's annual capital expenditure. For existing shareholders, the large-scale issuance of new shares will increase the number of outstanding shares, which may lead to a dilution of earnings per share, assuming other conditions remain unchanged. On the other hand, the company's proactive fundraising efforts may indicate that Intel is preparing funds for future investments, and the market will be watching to see if this reflects the company's increased confidence in its future orders and potential further expansion.

Intel has been increasing its investments in new processes, wafer factory equipment, and advanced packaging in recent years to re-establish its competitive advantage through expanded manufacturing capabilities. This year's significant stock price rebound has also enabled the company to take advantage of the high stock price to raise more funds through the capital market, reducing the pressure on its cash position due to large-scale expansion.
